kindNotes: modal.history.records: the root has no data-frame (a container: its own border and the 8 px gap)
modal.history.factions: the root has no data-frame (a container: its own border and the 8 px gap)
modal.history.thread-decision: the root has no data-frame (a container: its own border and the 8 px gap)

modal.year-review.data: 1302's card at 1303's first tick: its decisions (or none), the factions' moves, the town's people and money

modal.history.records.data: the stone town's chronicle: timeline, filters, record list, detail

modal.history.factions.data: chapter 4's factions: influence, tug of war, relations

modal.chronicle-book.data: the chronicle book's title page and contents

lord.screen.data: the lord screen host over the town: the left menu (each shut item with its reason) and the screen (empty until an area opens one)

lord.ledger.book.data: the promise book's drawn page inside the ledger: the promises' lines within it

lord.ledger.track.data: the suit's drawn stage track inside the ledger: the stages within it

lord.ledger.suit.data: the contested inheritance's suit just filed: the stage track, the hearing's two sides, the five evidence kinds to bring; two claims to file

lord.ledger.entry-threat.data: a forcible entry forewarned by a house past −60 (1344): the guard and the gift at the engine's costs, the engine's sentence

lord.estates.audit-pending.data: a visit's audit waiting for the lord's answer: what it found and the days left (the answer is the decision card's)

modal.lord.audit.data: a Michaelmas audit's finding: punish, replace, tolerate — what each recovers, who follows, who remembers

modal.lord.offmap-petition.data: an off-map estate's petition: why it came to the lord, both answers' treasury and the estate's goodwill

modal.history.thread-decision.data: the suit filed in 1300, opened from its later chip: what followed (its turns) and who remembers it

modal.year-review.lord.data: 1300's card on the engine's yearReview after a load (unseen): the lord's decisions, the steward's, what followed by decision, the town

hud.auto-pause.data: time run in the lord slice until the engine names a reason (the first, a great person's death): why it stopped, the ledger's line and the way on

hud.auto-pause.link.data: time run until a suit is judged: the judgment's line with the way to its suit on the ledger screen beside the way on
